project.name: Event Management System — Scrum Board
project.description: Scrum Board, User Story Backlog, and Kanban Workflow for EventSphere PBL

issues.title: [US-01] User Registration & Salted Hashing
issues.body:
### User Story
**As an** unregistered attendee,
**I want** to register an account with username, email, and password,
**So that** I can access the event ticketing platform securely.

### Scrum Metadata
- **Story Points:** 3
- **Priority:** 🔴 High (Must Have)
- **Sprint:** Sprint 1
- **Type:** User Story
- **Kanban Status:** 🟢 Done

### Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Validates unique username and email format.
- [x] Generates random salt and hashes password with SHA-256.
- [x] Prevents duplicate usernames or emails with clear error messages.

issues.title: [US-02] Secure Credential Authentication & Role Sessions
issues.body:
### User Story
**As a** registered user,
**I want** to log in using my credentials,
**So that** the system loads my authenticated session with role permissions.

### Scrum Metadata
- **Story Points:** 3
- **Priority:** 🔴 High (Must Have)
- **Sprint:** Sprint 1
- **Type:** User Story
- **Kanban Status:** 🟢 Done

### Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Verifies submitted password hash against stored salted hash.
- [x] Rejects invalid credentials cleanly without revealing sensitive data.
- [x] Assigns session role (`attendee`, `organizer`, `admin`).

issues.title: [US-03] Search & Filter Events by Category & Venue
issues.body:
### User Story
**As an** attendee,
**I want** to search events by category, venue, and title,
**So that** I can discover relevant events quickly.

### Scrum Metadata
- **Story Points:** 5
- **Priority:** 🔴 High (Must Have)
- **Sprint:** Sprint 2
- **Type:** User Story
- **Kanban Status:** 🟢 Done

### Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Case-insensitive keyword search across title and venue.
- [x] Category filtering (Technology, Coding, Cultural, Workshop).
- [x] Displays ticket pricing, schedule, and organizer details.

issues.title: [US-04] Real-time Seat Quota & Availability Query
issues.body:
### User Story
**As an** attendee,
**I want** to view real-time remaining seat capacity for any event,
**So that** I know ticket booking feasibility before reserving.

### Scrum Metadata
- **Story Points:** 3
- **Priority:** 🔴 High (Must Have)
- **Sprint:** Sprint 2
- **Type:** User Story
- **Kanban Status:** 🟢 Done

### Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Computes available seats dynamically as `total_capacity - booked_tickets`.
- [x] Updates remaining capacity in real-time upon booking and cancellation.
- [x] Marks event visually as 'Sold Out' when remaining seats reach 0.

issues.title: [US-05] Atomic Ticket Reservation & Concurrency Guard
issues.body:
### User Story
**As an** attendee,
**I want** to reserve event tickets in an atomic database transaction,
**So that** my booking is secured without any risk of overbooking race conditions.

### Scrum Metadata
- **Story Points:** 8
- **Priority:** 🔴 High (Must Have)
- **Sprint:** Sprint 3
- **Type:** User Story
- **Kanban Status:** 🟢 Done

### Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Executes reservation within atomic SQLite transaction (`BEGIN IMMEDIATE`).
- [x] Defensive concurrency check aborts requests exceeding remaining capacity.
- [x] Generates unique ticket reference code (e.g., `EVT-A1B2C3D4`).

issues.title: [US-06] Attendee Ticket History & Reservation Status
issues.body:
### User Story
**As an** attendee,
**I want** to view my active and past event tickets,
**So that** I can track my event schedule and reference codes.

### Scrum Metadata
- **Story Points:** 3
- **Priority:** 🟠 Medium (Should Have)
- **Sprint:** Sprint 3
- **Type:** User Story
- **Kanban Status:** 🟢 Done

### Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Returns all reservations linked to authenticated attendee account.
- [x] Displays event title, date, venue, ticket count, total fee, and status (`Confirmed`, `Cancelled`).

issues.title: [US-07] Ticket Cancellation & Capacity Recovery
issues.body:
### User Story
**As an** attendee,
**I want** to cancel an existing ticket reservation,
**So that** seat capacity is immediately recovered for other attendees.

### Scrum Metadata
- **Story Points:** 5
- **Priority:** 🔴 High (Must Have)
- **Sprint:** Sprint 4
- **Type:** User Story
- **Kanban Status:** 🟢 Done

### Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Sets ticket status to `Cancelled` with timestamp.
- [x] Atomically decrements `booked_tickets` count on event record.
- [x] Prevents duplicate or redundant cancellations.

issues.title: [US-08] Ticket Rescheduling & Event Transfer
issues.body:
### User Story
**As an** attendee,
**I want** to transfer my ticket to an alternative event,
**So that** I can update my attendance schedule cleanly in one step.

### Scrum Metadata
- **Story Points:** 5
- **Priority:** 🟠 Medium (Should Have)
- **Sprint:** Sprint 4
- **Type:** User Story
- **Kanban Status:** 🟢 Done

### Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Releases seats on old event atomically.
- [x] Locks seats on new target event atomically.
- [x] Updates ticket record with new event details and amount.

issues.title: [US-09] Real-time Booking Confirmation Receipts
issues.body:
### User Story
**As an** attendee,
**I want** to receive an immediate verifiable ticket receipt,
**So that** I have official proof of registration for venue entry.

### Scrum Metadata
- **Story Points:** 3
- **Priority:** 🟠 Medium (Should Have)
- **Sprint:** Sprint 5
- **Type:** User Story
- **Kanban Status:** 🟢 Done

### Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Displays ticket reference code, event date, venue, seats, and notes.

issues.title: [US-10] Organizer Event Publishing & Quota Management
issues.body:
### User Story
**As an** event organizer,
**I want** to publish new events with custom capacity and schedule,
**So that** attendees can register for my events.

### Scrum Metadata
- **Story Points:** 5
- **Priority:** 🔴 High (Must Have)
- **Sprint:** Sprint 2
- **Type:** User Story
- **Kanban Status:** 🟢 Done

### Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Validates title, category, venue, schedule, fee, and total capacity > 0.
- [x] Inserts new event into public catalog with status `Open`.

issues.title: [US-11] Platform Administrative Audit Log & Oversight
issues.body:
### User Story
**As an** administrator,
**I want** to inspect all events and registrations globally,
**So that** I can monitor platform utilization and transactional integrity.

### Scrum Metadata
- **Story Points:** 3
- **Priority:** 🟢 Low (Could Have)
- **Sprint:** Sprint 5
- **Type:** User Story
- **Kanban Status:** 🟢 Done

### Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Centralized audit log view across all organizers and ticket sales.

issues.title: [US-12] In-App Scrum Backlog, Sprint & Kanban Engine
issues.body:
### User Story
**As a** Scrum development team member,
**I want** to track user stories and Kanban workflows within the software,
**So that** our team transparently practices disciplined Agile software engineering.

### Scrum Metadata
- **Story Points:** 8
- **Priority:** 🔴 High (Must Have)
- **Sprint:** Sprint 5
- **Type:** User Story
- **Kanban Status:** 🟢 Done

### Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Persistent SQLite user stories and sprints tables.
- [x] Terminal ASCII Kanban board with 5 columns.
- [x] Standalone interactive Web Kanban board and dashboard.

issues.title: [TASK-01] Database Schema Setup & Foreign Key Verification
issues.body:
### Engineering Task
Implement SQLite schema for users, events, tickets, user_stories, and sprints tables with strict foreign key constraints.

### Scrum Metadata
- **Story Points:** 2
- **Priority:** 🔴 High
- **Sprint:** Sprint 1
- **Type:** Task
- **Kanban Status:** 🟢 Done

issues.title: [TASK-02] Concurrency-Safe Booking with BEGIN IMMEDIATE
issues.body:
### Engineering Task
Implement transaction locking using `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` to guarantee ticket reservations prevent capacity overshoot under concurrent access.

### Scrum Metadata
- **Story Points:** 5
- **Priority:** 🔴 High
- **Sprint:** Sprint 3
- **Type:** Task
- **Kanban Status:** 🟢 Done

issues.title: [TASK-03] Automated Capacity Recovery on Ticket Cancellation
issues.body:
### Engineering Task
Verify atomic decrement of `booked_tickets` when an attendee cancels a confirmed reservation.

### Scrum Metadata
- **Story Points:** 3
- **Priority:** 🔴 High
- **Sprint:** Sprint 4
- **Type:** Task
- **Kanban Status:** 🟢 Done

issues.body:
### Testing Task
Execute automated unit tests covering auth, event management, bookings, concurrency, cancellations, and Scrum engines.

### Scrum Metadata
- **Story Points:** 3
- **Priority:** 🔴 High
- **Sprint:** Sprint 5
- **Type:** Testing
- **Kanban Status:** 🟢 Done
